event: A frozen confirmatory model challenge failed only exact hand-authored soft routing-distribution similarity while decisive routing, semantic quality, disagreement handling, missing-view safety, and exact source anchors passed.
mistake_risk: Treating an internal latent routing percentage as ground-truth behavior can convert validation into an arbitrary representation constraint and provoke unnecessary repair training.
correction: Preserve the failed historical result unchanged. Audit the validator. Version the validator rather than changing old thresholds. Define outcome-relevant routing constraints such as allowed top-view sets, minimum/maximum mass, dominance margins, set-mass bounds, missing-view zero, and query-sensitive reversals. Evaluate the identical preselected checkpoint on a new untouched challenge before authorizing any gradient.
result: The unchanged checkpoint passed the corrected 160-row/20-family challenge with routing-constraint pass rate 1.0, worst-family routing pass 1.0, semantic cosine 0.949729336053133, worst-family semantic cosine 0.9197454825043678, zero routing violation, zero missing-view leakage, and exact source anchors. Fusion was then ratified.
general_rule: Validators should constrain externally meaningful capability, provenance, safety, or invariants. Do not force arbitrary internal representation geometry or percentages unless a calibrated model or grounded semantics justify them.
follow_on: For adaptive latent pooling, slots remain unlabeled learned carriers. Coverage is supervised without assigning fixed personality-trait meanings. Parameter/slot/view counts remain checkpoint shapes rather than permanent ceilings.
